title: 1 hr Lake Austin Boat Cruise. BYOB (Shared - Single Tickets)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Pickup drop-off address: 5019 N. Capital of Texas Highway.
Arrive 30 min prior. Parking lot is to right at bottom of the exit. Walk to wooden booth under the 360 bridge. Your with AUSTIN BOAT ADVENTURES!
$5 Cash Only per person to get into boat ramp at the wooden booth, paid separately.
Boarding. Very punctual on the hr. 5-10 min loading times. please arrive early to prevent delays.

Walk across the boat ramp to the water line. Meet your captain between the big cement pillars under the bridge. When ready to board they will call out anyone with Austin boat Adventures and assist with boarding. They will be on a Bentley pontoon boat
20% captain gratuity - paid to them separately at end of trip. $8 per ticket. Cash, venmo, zelle, or cashapp
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
(PICKUP and DROPOFF location: 5019 N. Capital of Texas Highway.)

Set out on a one-of-a-kind journey across the pristine waters of Lake Austin where natural beauty meets luxury living. Glide through the heart of the Texas Hill Country, catch an early morning sunrise, mid day sun trip (half bimini top for shade), scenic sunset cruise or an after hours night booze cruise (optional-Ski Shores Cafe for a quick cocktail.)

All while being surrounded by lush greenery, rolling landscapes, and stunning architectural real estate masterpieces that line the shoreline. 

It’s not just a boat ride — it’s an unforgettable Austin experience! 

*Trips may be rescheduled if minimum requirement is not met.
